transcription_check.scope: Faithful transcription of digital PDF, including visible defects; not archival verification.

notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l004: Chong Jindi is the childhood protective name, literally Great Madman; retained as a name consistent with surrounding narrative.
notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l010: Visible Чыкырган read contextually as чакырган (called); raw source not emended.
notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l013: Бечел rendered crippled in the hostile quotation about delayed walking; source insult retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l016: Опсолоң interpreted contextually as wild/reckless; exact lexical force needs specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l018: Бутун жыйнай басканы rendered gathering his feet beneath him and walking; exact gait is uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l036: Кыйбатын interpreted as precious/worthy ones, referring to the forty children; visible spelling preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l042: Кымбаттап оюн сал- provisionally rendered distinguishing himself in play; unusual verbal construction unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0116:b002:l044: Fifteen and sixteen interpreted as ages; source does not print жаш in this phrase. Number eighty retained separately.
notes.manas-2010:p0117:b002:l002: Оңбоду rendered behaved wickedly here; grammar shifts from eldest son to the eighty boys across the page break.
notes.manas-2010:p0117:b002:l003: Кызыталак is harsh sexual invective, rendered fucking to retain abusive register. Burut is the source outsider term for Kyrgyz, retained in dialogue.
notes.manas-2010:p0117:b002:l018: Bride-like bowing image retained; not literally becoming brides.
notes.manas-2010:p0117:b002:l020: Чымындай жан image retained as fly-sized soul/life; English soul is idiomatic rather than theological interpretation.
notes.manas-2010:p0117:b002:l022: Билегинен сап кеткен / Жүрөгүнөн кап кеткен treated as paired loss of strength and courage, not literal handle/sack loss.
notes.manas-2010:p0117:b002:l029: Даакы: foalskin coat or ragged clothing. 2015 explanatory dictionary quotes this exact line under figurative ragged-clothing sense; draft uses ragged coats. https://el-sozduk.kg/даакы/
notes.manas-2010:p0117:b002:l047: Literal oiled-wheat face retained as epic appearance formula; precise complexion implied not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0118:b002:l007: Кызыр чалган interpreted as touched by Khizir; кургуруң retained as familiar fellow, not rendered cursed in contradiction to blessing.
notes.manas-2010:p0118:b002:l013: Lines13–18 have abrupt syntax: the forty-household children are followed by apostrophe to topknotted Kalmyks. Draft punctuation is interpretive; specialist review required.
notes.manas-2010:p0118:b002:l017: Бууданын rendered your fine horse provisionally; possessive reference inferred from taunt, not independently established.
notes.manas-2010:p0118:b002:l022: Күрпөңдөшө interpreted contextually as brawling; precise connotation unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0118:b002:l027: Даакы rendered foalskin coat using Yudakhin and 2015 explanatory dictionary. https://el-sozduk.kg/даакы/
notes.manas-2010:p0118:b002:l029: Үйрө interpreted contextually as swinging the cudgel; exact printed form remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0118:b002:l032: Twelve deaths are explicit in source and repeated at lines46–47; repetition preserved rather than combined.
